Agent Name: TextExtraction_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent did not use the actual applicant data from the extracted files (e.g., Applicants.xlsx) and instead hard-coded a small sample of three applicants. They also used mismatched qualification strings (e.g., "C++, C#, or Fortran experience" vs entries like "C++" or "C++, C#"), causing incorrect comparison logic. This led to an inaccurate count of applicants missing a single qualification (reported as 1) instead of the correct 17.
